acceptance: A genuine reusable FlightData cache with a malformed shard is rejected with the bad-width error and is not replaced.
Missing-manifest source-contract behavior remains covered and passes.
The fix PR targets develop and merges before this item closes.
context: PR https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/pull/2322 at b40ec340bbd505123f3d4609e2fcd4f0445097d7. Existing manifest-free cache regeneration was intentional; the bad-width test had no manifest and never exercised reuse. The regression now creates a valid manifested cache, corrupts a shard, constructs a second downloader, and asserts the 27-versus-28-width error plus unchanged manifest/shard bytes. Fourteen focused tests and committed-head make pr-preflight passed (31495 fast, 2090 medium); hosted CI is green with no review threads. Maintainer approval and merge into develop remain before closing.
description: The release canary's bad-width shard test became stale when source-contract pinning made manifest-free caches regenerate. Build a genuine reusable shard cache with a matching manifest, corrupt one row, and verify download rejects that shard without replacing the manifest or cache. Preserve the product's fail-closed reuse validation and the no-manifest regeneration policy; do not skip tests or change markers.
